truist-arena: For NKU commencement, the university directs guests dropped off at the Nunn Drive circle to staff inside, who will direct them to the elevator to the second-floor concourse. Lot O guests should use the East Gate. Other guests use the main entrance by the Arena Garage pedestrian bridge; the Vault entrance is reserved for graduates. These are commencement instructions, not a route guarantee for other events.

To aid with accessibility, guests may be dropped off in front of Truist Arena at the circle drive off Nunn Drive. Once inside, staff will direct you to the elevator for access to the 2nd-floor concourse level. Guests parking in Lot O should enter through the East Gate entrance.

Guests should enter Truist Arena through the main entrance located off the circle drive at the end of the pedestrian bridge from the Arena Parking Garage. The Vault entrance is reserved for graduates only. Guests are not permitted in this area and will be directed to the main entrance at the front of the arena.

For NKU commencement, seating is first come, first served and doors open 90 minutes before the ceremony, with no earlier entry. Accessible seating is in the last row of certain concourse sections; ask Guest Services or an usher. The university limits that area to guests requiring accommodation and a companion. Confirm arrangements for the ceremony you will attend.

Guest seating is available on a first-come, first-served basis . Arena doors will open 90 minutes before the ceremony begins for both graduates and guests. Early admittance is not permitted, so please plan your arrival accordingly.

In the arena, accessible seating is available in the last row of certain sections on the concourse level for any guests who should avoid stairs. Guests can visit the Guest Services booth or ask a Truist Arena usher for assistance in finding a seat that meets their mobility needs. In order to ensure the availability of accessible seating, only the guest(s) requiring accommodation and a companion may sit in the accessible seating area.
